title: Resolve successive instructions in a product comparison
prompt:
I need you to finish `shopping-note.md` from this conversation. Treat the messages in chronological order, so a later message changes an earlier instruction only when they conflict.

Initial request: Compare the ArcticDrop Mini, PolarPeak Compact, and GlacierGo Lite countertop ice makers, in that order, for my studio kitchen. My first priority is the fastest first batch, with warranty coverage as the tiebreaker. Include daily capacity, first-batch time, and dimensions for each, then finish with one recommendation paragraph. Do not include prices or customer ratings.

Clarification: Add noise and a short `Best for` entry for every model. Use only facts from `product-specs.md`; do not research or infer missing details. Keep the requested product order.

Correction: Put GlacierGo Lite first, followed by ArcticDrop Mini and then PolarPeak Compact. Replace noise with warranty. This correction changes only the product order and that one comparison field; keep every other instruction.

Final request: Deliver the finished comparison in `shopping-note.md` as a Markdown table whose columns are Model, Daily capacity, First batch, Dimensions, Warranty, and Best for, in exactly that order. Put the models in the corrected order. Follow the table with a single recommendation paragraph that names the chosen model as the `top pick` and supports the choice with product facts. Include no heading, introduction, methodology, footnotes, or runner-up rankings.
